name: Kanban
purpose: Three-column board composed from card, tag, and list. Cards move with labeled buttons.
scenarios: Scan cards grouped into to do, in progress, and done
Move a card forward or back with the keyboard
Show an empty state when a column has no cards

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for bundled block copy.

onMove.description: Called after a card is moved to another column.

variants.name: density
variants.description: Inherits density from token rungs rather than a local viewport query.

states.name: default
states.description: The board has one or more cards.

antiPatterns: Do not ship a custom pointer-drag engine in this block. Phase 7 forbids a homegrown kanban drag stack; movement is keyboard-first labeled buttons.
Do not claim 21 authored languages; 19 locales are ICU skeletons.

keyboard: Enter or Space activates a move
a11y.focus: Move actions stay in document order with a visible focus ring.
a11y.labeling: Each move action includes the card title. Columns have headings.

responsive.strategy: Board uses @container with the tablet rem token; no viewport media queries.

breakpoints.medium: Columns become three at 48rem container inline-size.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction comes from locale language.
